Ever since the introduction of Bitcoin in 2008, Cryptocurrencies and the Blockchain technology
have become very popular contributing to a lot of excitement and hype in business circles. While
crypto-currencies have not been welcomed warmly, especially by the regulators, the usefulness
of Blockchain, the technology underpinning Bitcoin has been universally recognized 1 (even by
detractors of cryptocurrencies). Increasingly, Blockchain technology is finding applications
outside the Fintech industry including areas such as Supply chain management, fraud detection,
health, agriculture, education, government and the like. With this kind of proliferation, it is not
inconceivable that present and future managers will encounter Blockchain in some form sooner
rather than later.
This course intends to equip student, the present and future managers, with relevant and working
knowledge of Cryptocurrencies and the Blockchain technology. Blockchain, a potentially
disruptive technology has various known and potentially useful applications across various
industry verticals.
Course Objectives:

The main objective of this course is to equip students with an understanding of the emerging
technology of blockchain that will enable them to:
- Assess the applicability of Blockchain technology and its business benefits in business
contexts that are characterized by “trust” mechanisms.
- Understand the interaction between different Blockchain components.
- Where and how to implement Blockchain
- Design innovative Blockchain Applications
